skill.description: Helps users create structured SKILL.md files for AI agent skills, with guidance for naming, descriptions, workflows, examples, and quality checks.
skill.summary: Create clear, well-structured SKILL.md files with templates, examples, and validation guidance.
skill.author: YYH211

security_audit.summary: All static findings were reviewed in context and appear to be documentation false positives. The repository contains Markdown guidance, templates, and examples, not active code that executes commands, reads secrets, or performs network activity.

remediation.issue: Security scanners flag many Markdown code fences and inline examples as executable command use.
remediation.suggestion: Add a short safety note that examples are illustrative and require user approval before any command is run.

remediation.issue: The guide uses secret-like placeholder names such as INTERNAL_API_KEY and SECRET_KEY.
remediation.suggestion: Label these as placeholders and advise authors to avoid storing or exposing real secrets in skill files.

remediation.issue: Example skills include shell commands, package installation, and validation tools.
remediation.suggestion: State that generated skills should request confirmation before running commands or installing dependencies.

content.value_statement: Creating reliable agent skills requires clear structure, triggers, and examples. This skill provides templates and review checks for SKILL.md files.
actual_capabilities: Explains the required frontmatter for SKILL.md files.
Provides naming and description rules for discoverable skills.
Shows basic and workflow skill templates.
Includes examples of strong and weak skill designs.
Defines quality checks for structure, examples, and maintenance.
limitations: Does not validate a skill against an official parser.
Does not create files automatically without user direction.
Does not test generated skills inside Claude or Codex.
Examples may need adaptation for each project.

use_cases.title: Create a New Agent Skill
use_cases.description: Draft a SKILL.md file with frontmatter, trigger scenarios, workflow steps, and examples.

use_cases.title: Improve Skill Discoverability
use_cases.description: Rewrite names and descriptions so agents can activate the right skill at the right time.

use_cases.title: Review Skill Quality
use_cases.description: Check a skill for structure, useful examples, clear boundaries, and maintainable documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Basic Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple SKILL.md outline.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a SKILL.md for a skill that helps with [task]. Include frontmatter, trigger scenarios, workflow steps, and two examples.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an Existing Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for editing a draft.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this SKILL.md draft for naming, description quality, structure, examples, and missing validation steps. Suggest concrete edits.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Workflow Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a multi-step process.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a workflow skill for [process]. Include phases, decision points, success criteria, failure handling, and expected artifacts.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Skill Library
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for consistency across several skills.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these skills for overlap, naming conflicts, unclear triggers, and maintenance risks. Recommend merges, rewrites, or splits.

output_examples.input: Create a skill for generating API documentation from a Python web app.
output_examples.output: A structured SKILL.md outline with activation triggers, discovery steps, documentation workflow, validation checks, and example outputs.

output_examples.input: Review this skill description: Helps with code tasks.
output_examples.output: A clearer description that names the task, tool context, activation phrases, and expected user outcome.

output_examples.input: Turn my deployment checklist into a skill.
output_examples.output: A workflow skill plan with ordered phases, stop conditions, success criteria, failure handling, and artifact reporting.

best_practices: Use specific trigger phrases that match real user requests.
Keep workflow steps concrete and include clear success criteria.
Add examples that show input, action, and expected output.
anti_patterns: Do not use vague names such as helper or utility.
Do not include general knowledge the agent already knows.
Do not omit boundaries for scripts, tools, or external commands.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create SKILL.md files for agent skills, including frontmatter, workflows, examples, and quality checks.

faq.question: Can it write a complete skill from a short idea?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft a complete structure when the user provides the task, audience, and expected workflow.

faq.question: Does it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It documents possible commands and workflows, but command execution still depends on the host agent and user approval.

faq.question: Is it useful for Claude Code and Codex users?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains skill structure in a way that can guide Claude, Claude Code, and Codex workflows.

faq.question: Can it review an existing skill?
faq.answer: Yes. It can check naming, descriptions, examples, workflow clarity, and missing maintenance guidance.

faq.question: What information should I provide first?
faq.answer: Provide the task, the target user, the tools involved, and examples of requests that should activate the skill.
